name: Shams al-Dīn Aḥmad ibn Sulaymān ibn Kamāl Pāshā
summary: Ottoman şeyhülislâm and historian whose al-Falāḥ is one of the classical commentaries on Marāḥ al-arwāḥ, the last book of the Ottoman ṣarf course.
bio: Kemalpaşazâde began as a soldier and turned to learning, becoming one of the great scholars of the Ottoman state: judge, professor, and from 932/1526 şeyhülislâm under Süleymān. He wrote in Arabic, Persian and Turkish on law, theology, history and language.

For the madrasa he wrote al-Falāḥ fī sharḥ al-Marāḥ, a commentary on Aḥmad ibn ʿAlī ibn Masʿūd's Marāḥ al-arwāḥ, which the TDV names with Dunqūz's and al-ʿAynī's among its chief commentaries. He died in Istanbul in 940/1534.
